Program Description

This is one of the UK’s most recognized courses within the field, and it is well respected by the industry. The breadth of subjects covered means that the course is relevant to a range of computing careers - from programming, mobile development and network management to systems security and artificial intelligence systems. This course gives students the chance to be taught by experienced developers and internationally recognized researchers.

This course prepares students for a wide range of careers in varied industries including software development, financial services, management and games companies.

Recent graduates have found employment with companies such as IBM, Amazon, Schlumberger, Ordnance Survey, Codemasters and npower.

Program Description

Students follow this specialist route if they are a practitioner working or intending to work in the early years sector. Students draw on their own personal and professional experience, practice and interests to explore an area of early childhood studies that is particularly relevant to students and their career development.

The core modules in this MA enable students to update their knowledge and skills and give students the opportunity to reflect on their professional practice whilst developing an understanding of theoretical models and current debates. There is a strong emphasis on the application of the studies to a professional context. Students study two modules; Using the Literature to Inform Educational Research and the Dissertation. They choose their topics which should be around current debates and issues in early childhood studies.
4zl2:
Program Description

If students are experienced educational professionals in a leadership role this course is for them. Students explore an aspect of leadership relevant to their own interests and career development. Students reflect on practice in their own organization, identify areas of professional concern and explore their own approach to leadership using a range of diagnostic tools for self-assessment.

The core modules in this MA enable students to update their knowledge and skills and give students the opportunity to reflect on their professional practice whilst developing their understanding of theoretical models and current debates. There is a strong emphasis on the application of students' studies to their professional context.

Students study two modules, Using the Literature to Inform Educational Research and the Dissertation. These modules are pieces of extended supervised work and the topic, which is chosen by the student, must be in an area of leadership. By opting for this named route, students achieve a qualification which showcases this specialism clearly to employers.
501x:
Program Description

The LLM enhances their knowledge of the fundamental principles of law, combined with the flexibility to explore their own interests with support from research-active teaching staff. The underlying philosophy of this course is to enable students to continue their professional, educational and personal development by consolidating, enhancing and extending your disciplinary expertise, professional ethics, experience and abilities.

Students develop recognized subject-specific knowledge and understanding as well as cognitive, intellectual, practical, professional and generic key skills and qualities. The course enables students to more effectively plan, manage and evaluate their own learning to become an independent lifelong learner. Students work with complex knowledge, theory and concepts appropriate to postgraduate study and are required to demonstrate high levels of personal responsibility and self-direction.

The LLM course is the result of research carried out by academics and lawyers in the School of Social Sciences, Humanities & Law to develop a programme focusing on the philosophical theories that underpin the law, and building on current perspectives in law. It focuses on the underlying legal theories that determine the scope of the existing law and proposals for changes to legislation and the common law.

502a:
Program Description

This course facilitates the transfer of knowledge from academic public health to the practice environment by translating research findings into actions that can be understood and acted upon by practitioners and the public. It offers enhanced opportunities for students wishing to pursue studies in the academic and applied world of public health.

The MPH/DPH courses offer a distinguished broader-based learning programme aligned with the growing worldwide interest in public health development. Teaching focuses on core concepts and principles underpinning public health practice and policy development, which can be applied in a variety of settings. Students are encouraged to apply these concepts and principles to their own area of practice or interest through the assessments they complete.
502b:
Program Description

A master’s degree in public health helps students develop the advanced critical thinking, administrative and problem solving skills they need to prepare them to lead public health teams, initiatives and research in the UK and internationally. Students apply contemporary public health theory to practice, developing a critical understanding of complex global public health issues, and translate theoretical scientific knowledge in public health into tangible sustainable interventions for improved health.

The two-year master’s degree with applied practice offers students the chance to enhance their qualification by spending one semester completing a vocational internship, research internship or an opportunity to study abroad.
4zjz:
Program Description

In a challenging and complex economic climate, there is an ever-increasing demand for reflective, entrepreneurial and responsible business leaders with the necessary skills, understanding and acumen to tackle the difficult challenges facing organisations of all sizes. Teesside University's MBA is designed to develop and enhance students' strategic leadership skills to manage this demand.

Students explore topics that will enhance their knowledge of key concepts as well as having the opportunity to directly apply skills to add value to the workplace or, for those studying full time with us, add value by working on real-time projects with Teesside's partners, contributing to the organization and enhancing their own development.

By studying this MBA, students not only gain an internationally renowned qualification but they will develop entrepreneurial and leadership skills to make an immediate impact in the workplace. If students aspire to make a significant contribution to their organization and society more generally by leading at a strategic level, this is the course for them.
86pc:
Students explore topics that enhance their knowledge of key concepts while also having the opportunity to directly apply skills by working on real-time projects with partners, contributing to the organization and fostering their own development.

By studying for an MBA, they gain an internationally recognized qualification and become capable of making an immediate impact in the workplace. This particular MBA enables students to develop employability skills and gain UK experience, further enhancing their employability. For those aspiring to make a significant contribution by leading at a strategic level, this course is an ideal choice. Upon completion of the MBA Global program, graduates will:

  • Think and act entrepreneurially, leading through uncertain and rapidly changing conditions in the global business environment.
  • Become responsible leaders able to work with diverse teams in various cultural contexts.
  • Maintain an international perspective and understand the challenges and opportunities presented by the global business environment.
  • Acquire a deep understanding of business functions and appreciate the importance of functional collaboration to achieve organizational goals.
  • Emerge as self-reflective practitioners with a keen awareness of their self-identity and values.
  • Understand the importance of the role of business in society.
